post.summary: Update question draft from Widget schema format
post.description: Updates a question draft by converting from Widget schema format. Use Content-Type: application/vnd.weavr.widget+json.

post.summary: Get multiple published questions in Widget schema format
post.description: Returns the latest published version of each requested question in Widget schema format. Questions not found or without a widget mapper are listed in 'missing'.

post.summary: Create a new question from Widget schema format
post.description: Creates a question by converting from Widget schema format (MCQ, Dropdown, FIB, etc.). Use Content-Type: application/vnd.weavr.widget+json. The widget type is auto-detected from the JSON structure.

get.summary: Get question in Widget schema format
get.description: Retrieves a question converted to Widget schema format (e.g., MCQWidget). Use Accept: application/vnd.weavr.widget+json. Returns HTTP 400 if question type doesn't support widget format.
